Offshore Waters Forecast
NWS Ocean Prediction Center Washington DC
325 PM EST Sun Nov 15 2026

New England continental shelf and slope waters from 60 nm
offshore to the Hague Line, except to 1000 fm south of New
England.

Seas given as significant wave height, which is the average
height of the highest 1/3 of the waves. Individual waves may be
more than twice the significant wave height.

Locally higher winds and seas can be expected in and near tstms.

ANZ898-160745-
325 PM EST Sun Nov 15 2026

.SYNOPSIS FOR NEW ENGLAND WATERS...High pressure will build over
the eastern US tonight. High pressure will then expand over the 
western Atlantic Mon and Tue then persist into Fri night. Over
the waters a trough will persist into tonight then weaken as high
pressure builds towards the region. A trough will develop along
the New England coast Tue then persist into Fri night.  


$$
